The '''Rim Campaign''' was a military endeavor undertaken by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] around [[3660 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The campaign was overseen by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] and the [[Dark Council]], but was personally led by [[Darth Malgus]] and his comrade, [[Darth Venemal]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was able to strike back against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and take the fighting to the [[Seat of The Empire|heart of their Empire]], was led by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]], who scored several victories, but was ultimately driven out of the region.
